name: Simple Money Tracker
blurb: A simple personal accounting app designed to make it easy to keep track of your income and expenses on your Android device.
description:
A simple personal accounting app designed to make it easy to keep track of your income and expenses on your Android device.

Features:
• Fast and easy entry and editing of income and expenses.

• Summary balance sheet and income/expense statement shows you where you stand on selected period.

• Easy reconciliation with your bank statements.

• Import/Export .csv files.
